brand.name: Rosemary Epass
brand.palette: Official light/dark semantic tokens; paper and pine
brand.identityCompatibility: Existing storage keys, issuer URLs, RP IDs and published legal records are preserved.

motion.timingSource: CSS semantic tokens, resolved at runtime for Web Animations
motion.selection: Measured shared indicator; immediate single live panel; interrupted movement resumes current transform
motion.dialogs: Native modality closes immediately; only inert, aria-hidden visual exit is retained
motion.navigation: View Transition snapshots for internal links and explicit navigation; single live-content transition for history/redirect fallback; initial load and query-only changes stay static
motion.preferences: Reactive system reduced motion plus persisted rosemary_motion; spinners pause when document is hidden

validation.motionHarness: web/tests/browser/motion.html (Vite dev server; reload before each run)
manualChecks: Desktop light/dark login, account and dashboard
320px login, registration, recovery and documentation: no horizontal page overflow
390px admin user table: contained horizontal scrolling
320px native account dialog, keyboard select, Escape and restored trigger focus
Standalone authorization consent and error pages; local logo visible
Login/register page direction and main-content focus
13 page fixtures at 320px without horizontal page overflow
320px OIDC editor; Escape restores trigger focus
Live registration feedback: length, common password, edge whitespace, valid two-category passphrase
Admin new-user weak-password feedback and disabled create action
Documentation native contents link locates a stable chapter ID
limitations: Account/admin previews use synthetic local fixtures; no live backend end-to-end login or credential changes were performed.
Safari, Firefox, real mobile hardware, screen readers and OS-level preference changes have not been manually verified.
Animation values and intermediate computed state were tested in browser; no frame-by-frame video review was performed.

passwordPolicy.rules: 8–128 printable ASCII characters; at least two of letters, digits and symbols; spaces do not count as symbols; no edge spaces; reject known common/decorated/repeated patterns
passwordPolicy.advice: Long unique passphrases; avoid account information; use a password manager. Cross-site or historical password reuse is not assessed by the client.
passwordPolicy.feedback: Immediate local checks with linked field descriptions and polite status; invalid passwords disable submission in registration, recovery and admin creation.
passwordPolicy.compatibility: New-password policy only. Existing weak and non-ASCII hashes still verify.
passwordPolicy.referenceNote: Google guidance informs advice; the 8-character minimum and two-category requirement are product requirements.

flutterSdk.status: Upstream Prototype; manual assistive-technology acceptance not complete
